comment: Areas 2-4: per-area piles and backgrounds, plus the fence and sprinkler retried. Backgrounds are img2img over the game's own procedural scenery (tools/render_scenery.ts), which keeps the flat ground the lanes need; a plain text prompt draws street-level perspective.
style: children's picture book illustration, soft watercolour fills, bold dark ink outlines

prefix.sprite: one cute character sticker, whole body with white space around it, plain white background
prefix.object: one object sticker, whole object with white space around it, plain white background, no scenery

suffix.background: wide landscape, no characters, no animals, no people
